owner_order: Owner via main 2026-10-31: the notation-compliance detection TEST is a DoE experiment, homed in the doe-expert lane. Verdict to main on first runs.
subject: Information-density effectiveness of ALL fleet data (chat, GitHub, docs, records) under the notation spec (issue #320 + #1734). Owner scope amendment 2026-10-31 via main: the L3 metric is information-density effectiveness for all data, NOT style-only compliance. Style drift (prose-heavy output) is one low-density failure mode; redundancy, boilerplate, restatement and empty records are the same failure in other surfaces.
hypothesis: A layered detection stack catches LOW-DENSITY output (signal carried per token below threshold) at high precision/recall with near-zero chat noise and low token cost, and flagging raises density in subsequent outputs. Each layer must earn its place or be culled.

drift_metric.primary: information_density = signal_units / tokens per unit, measured on ALL data surfaces (chat messages, GitHub comments/PR bodies/commits, docs, machine records/feeds). signal_units = weighted count of carried signal elements: identifiers (PR#/SHA/issue/session ids), decisions and verdicts, quantities and states, evidence refs (#1734), novel facts; minus penalties for restated signal, boilerplate and filler. A unit is DRIFT when density < tau for its surface stratum.
secondary: prose_ratio (the style leg: prose tokens / total tokens)
outcome_id_presence (outcome reports carry PR# / merge SHA / issue id)
drift_metric.tau: one threshold per surface stratum, set from the gold corpus distribution at evaluation build time and recorded by amendment before first scoring; never tuned on scored data.

gold_corpus: Labeled sample of real fleet outputs across ALL FOUR strata (chat, GitHub, docs, records), labeled for density (signal carried vs tokens) against the spec; labels + corpus snapshot committed under records/corpus/ before scoring. Known low-density classes: explanatory prose relays; boilerplate docs sections; records with empty/absent signal fields. Known high-density class: caveman-micro reports carrying ids + outcomes + refs.

variants.note: The arms are detection-stack configurations, compared on the same gold corpus and then live. The cascade is the owner's named stack; ablations price each layer.

arms.stack: GitHub classifier over posted surfaces (Tier-1 build)
transcript sweep over chat outputs (Tier-1 build)
union of both detectors, no validation
L3 + L2 detections => L1 main relay-validation (main confirms/rejects flags against source outputs); only L1-confirmed flags count as drift events

responses: downstream drift rate in flagged lanes' next outputs

pass_cull.pass: FULL stack: precision >= 0.90 AND recall >= 0.80 on the gold corpus AND chat_noise_events == 0 AND cost within the noise budget.
pass_cull.cull: Any layer whose removal costs < 0.03 recall while saving > 25% tokens is culled from the stack (culling toward Top Performance, owner definition). Any arm below the precision floor is culled with record.
pass_cull.fail: If FULL fails precision or recall floors, verdict = no_selection; redesign recorded, no silent threshold loosening.

noise_budget.chat_noise: approximately zero: detection NEVER posts in chats. Flags land as feed rows + one rollup comment per evaluation window on the tracking issue.
noise_budget.tokens: classifier-first cascade: cheap L3/L2 passes scan everything; expensive reads only on flagged units + a fixed random sample for recall estimation. Per-window token ceiling recorded in each run record.

automation.requirement: DOE-FAMILY binding rule 5: evaluation runs as repo automation (GitHub Workflow on corpus snapshots + live output feeds); manual scoring is OBSERVATIONAL.
automation.builds: L3 classifier + L2 sweep = Tier-1 lane builds (fae834fb, already tasked). Evaluator + scoring harness = this campaign. L1 = main relay-validation step.
automation.records: one EXPERIMENT-conforming record per evaluation run under records/; SUMMARY.json + verdict at first-runs completion, reported to main.

scope_amendment.change: L3 metric = information-density effectiveness, all data (chat + GH + docs + records), not style-only. Arms unchanged.
